overview_description.description: Spotlight Realty is a company that administers properties and deals in residential real estate in a polished manner. Their customers' needs in terms of comfort, convenience, and reliability may differ from those of other customers. They assist clients to achieve and even surpass their corporate goals by leveraging their knowledge, insight, and influence in the market. They are based on relationships and assist clients in purchasing, leasing, or selling real estate. They make a lot of effort to simplify real estate transactions for their clientele.

about_short_description.short_description: Spotlight Realty is a property management company that provides property buying and selling services.

product.name: Home Buying Services
product.description: Assistance in purchasing residential properties in the Raleigh-Durham area, including guidance through the home search, offer, and closing processes.

product.name: Home Selling Services
product.description: Support for homeowners to sell their properties, including home valuation, marketing, offer negotiation, and transaction management.

product.name: Home Valuation
product.description: Providing estimates of current property market value to assist buyers and sellers in making informed decisions.

product.name: Mortgage Calculator
product.description: An online tool to estimate monthly mortgage payments including principal, interest, taxes, insurance, HOA fees, and PMI.

product.name: Neighborhood Information Services
product.description: Providing detailed information about local neighborhoods in the Raleigh-Durham area to assist clients in choosing suitable locations.
